messages:
jordan (support): FYI ticket #C-4382 from Acme reports a 403 when calling /v1/generate. They think the API key is invalid. Customer pasted this response:

{
  "error": {
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "message": "403 Forbidden",
    "code": "access_denied"
  }
}

They say this started after they toggled some feature flags in their app. Asking for quick triage. @mike can you take a look? :thinking_face:

mike (eng): on it. can you paste the raw request/headers from the customer? that usually tells whether it's a missing scope vs entitlement gating.

jordan (support): pasted below (redacted keys):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live_REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"gpt-5-large","prompt":"hi"}'

Response body they sent (raw):

HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":{"message":"access denied","code":"plan_entitlement_required","details":{"required_plan":"pro","resource":"gpt-5-large"}}}

mike (eng): aha — this is not a missing API key. server is rejecting because the model is gated by plan. code = plan_entitlement_required. customer SDK likely maps any 403 to an auth problem which is why they assumed key invalid.

jordan (support): interesting. customer insists they were on Pro. lee (billing), can you confirm Acme account status?

lee (billing): checked account id 8642 — billing shows their plan flagged as "Pro-trial" and it expired yesterday. no invoice failures. they didn't elect to convert to paid pro. so the entitlement check is correct: they lost access to gpt-5-large when trial expired. pinging customer with the billing link.

alyssa (product): two follow-ups: (1) UX — we should make the API error clearer so SDKs/frontends don't conflate entitlement 403 with auth. (2) docs — show common error shapes for plan gating.

mike (eng): Agreed. technical notes: current behavior returns HTTP 403 with body:{

  "error":{
    "message":"access denied","code":"plan_entitlement_required","details":{...}
  }
}

Most client libs swallow 403 and surface "invalid_key" in our support flows. Proposal: add an explicit http header `X-Redwood-Error-Type: entitlement` and ensure code string is stable. Also update JS SDK to throw EntitlementError (distinct from AuthError).

jordan (support): concrete steps for this thread: 1) Confirmed cause (trial expired). 2) Notified customer with recovery options: a) downgrade to available model (gpt-4-small) b) upgrade plan c) request temporary extension. I sent the standard billing link and included repro and suggested message for their engineers.

ops-bot: [deploy] canary rollout 2026-03-15T12:01:00 - plan-entitlement-error-headers added to staging

mike (eng): I'll open a small infra change: add `X-Redwood-Error-Type: entitlement` on entitlement 403s and a stable `error.code` value. Also updating the JS SDK error mapping. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/442

alyssa (product): filing a docs task and a short changelog blurb so customers know to check `error.code` and the header. Also we should add an example to troubleshooting: "403 but API key valid — check plan entitlements and model access".

lee (billing): emailed Acme billing contact with upgrade link and trial conversion options. cc'd support.

jordan (support): customer replied, accepted temporary extension for 48 hours while they evaluate upgrade. I granted a one-time entitlement override. forwarded confirmation to lee.

mike (eng): for follow-up, recommend we update support runbook — common pitfall: internal apps catching 403 and reauthing automatically which hides real cause. We'll add repro snippet to runbook:

```
# reproduce entitlement gating locally
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live_REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"gpt-5-large","prompt":"test"}'
```

Check for header `X-Redwood-Error-Type: entitlement` and `error.code == plan_entitlement_required`.

jordan (support): closing loop: customer back online, they downgraded temporarily. keeping thread open until SDK publishes. tagging for follow-up tasks: @mike update SDK (PR#442), @alyssa docs task, @lee confirm billing email sent.

mike (eng): will merge SDK change tomorrow morning and add a migration note.

alyssa (product): also suggest a short product tweak: add more explicit error messaging in hosted console when a model is gated — show "Upgrade to pro to use gpt-5-large" instead of generic forbidden. filing product ticket PROD-980.

jordan (support): thanks all. marking support ticket resolved, leaving notes in CRM. close thread after SDK release. :white_check_mark:
